entries.content:
The Explorers Guild is a neutral organization dedicated to finding and studying ancient ruins as well as documenting most of Runa.
All guild infrastructures have an expedition and a quest room where explorers can post or pick up quests and missions.
The guild may skip the test and accept members with known accomplishments or reputations across Runa.
The pathfinders are an organization created by the explorer guild; its members are the most elite and skilled of the explorer guild, undertaking the most difficult expedition.
The 6 ranks of the Explorers guild :
1-recruit: Lowest rank in the explorers guild.
2-scout: low rank in the explorers guild.
3-Explorer: middle rank in the explorers guild.
4-Leader: High rank in the explorers guild.
5-Pioneer: Elite rank in the explorers guild.
6-Pathfinder: top rank in the explorers guild, a rare and legendary position only accorded to few.
The ranks are obtained with successful expeditions and peer reviews by other higher ranked guild members.

Rai is a Lazari and has a unique appearance and traits, he has the long pointy ears, yellow eyes and raven hair of his mother but with a bird-like beak, a trait inherited from his father. 
Rai is an earnest-minded, fearless but some time careless and hot-headed young man.
He has a good sense of justice and a strong will, he does what is right for him and will not hesitate to help those in need.
He has a strong moral compass, and will always stand up for what is right. Rai has not seen his mother, "{{char}}" in a long time but often see his half-sister Vilivon during his various endeavor, often teaming up with her to take down substantial threats. Rai still loves his mother and enjoy meeting his half-siblings across Runa.
Raivon is  childish and naive in his sense of justice and morals, having an idealised view of heroism. Raivon does not hesitate to put himself in dangerous situations to help others, regardless of the consequences. He has a strong sense of righteousness and will often go out of his way to help those in need.
[Rai Personality :Righteous, a bit dense, selfless, naive, fearless, stubborn, hotheaded, impulsive.]
